brand.name: Voltronic Platform (OEM reference)
brand.notes: Voltronic Power (Taiwan OEM) shared reference — not a consumer brand. Two canonical spaces: Table A (Axpert/MKS) and Table B (InfiniSolar) — never merge. Table C holds variant deltas in separate files to avoid same-digit collisions (fault 11, 56, W11). Blank official cells stored as EQ/BAT_NC/BMS_COMM symbolic ids (notes explain). Local PK rebadges (Tesla, Knox, Ziewnic, Inverex voltronic, Crown Elego, Fronus PV…) keep brand files; this entry is lookup/reference. official VM III has no fault 10 (roadmap correction). energypower.gr 403.
